title: High Expressive Ratio / Mobile family
slide_intent: Compare variation within a repeated format so expressive range does not erase a recognizable family.
strategic_value: Recurring type, yellow and line drawings can connect Mailchimp messages about different features.
demonstration: Two rows of cropped mobile layouts combine yellow and pastel panels, serif headlines, teal actions and circled illustrations.
practical_value: Identify which elements repeat while image, message and background vary.

content_islands.name: Upper row
content_islands.spec: Arrange the five tall page examples across the upper half, retaining their source crop.

content_islands.name: Lower row
content_islands.spec: Place the second row beneath with illustration-led feature messages.

content_islands.name: Comparison marks
content_islands.spec: Keep black circles around illustrations to emphasize variation within the common format.

reference_purposes.Application: Multiple mobile layouts apply recurring identity elements to feature communications.
reference_purposes.Expression: The marked illustrations vary while the layouts retain related typography and color.

ingredient.name: Mobile illustration family
ingredient.role: Differentiate feature stories within a recognizable interface.
ingredient.application: Pair a distinct illustration with each feature while retaining shared typographic and action treatments.
ingredient.scope: Observed examples; the repeated outer columns are part of the supplied comparison board.
